description: This file declares the TpmGatekeeper class, which interfaces with the TPM to implement gatekeeper functionalities such as key retrieval, signature computation, failure record management, and others. It extends the gatekeeper::GateKeeper class and includes method declarations related to TPM-based secure environment management.

classes.name: TpmGatekeeper
classes.description: Implements the gatekeeper interface using TPM resources for secure key management, cryptographic operations, and failure record handling within a secure environment.

methods.name: TpmGatekeeper
methods.description: Constructor initializing TpmGatekeeper with references to TPM resource manager and secure/insecure storage.

methods.name: GetAuthTokenKey
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token key and its length.

methods.name: GetPasswordKey
methods.description: Retrieves the password key used in cryptographic operations.

methods.name: ComputePasswordSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature over the password using a specified key and salt.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Generates random data of requested size.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature over a message with a given key.

methods.name: GetMillisecondsSinceBoot
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed since system boot.

methods.name: GetFailureRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the failure record for a specific user ID and user secret.

methods.name: ClearFailureRecord
methods.description: Clears the failure record for a specified user.

methods.name: WriteFailureRecord
methods.description: Stores a failure record for a user.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Checks if the security implementation is backed by hardware.
